items.q: Do I need any technical skills?
items.a: None at all. If you can type a message, you can use these prompts. No AI knowledge or technical background required. Everything is ready to copy and paste.

items.q: Which AI tools do the prompts work with?
items.a: All major AI tools — ChatGPT (free or Plus), Claude, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot. You do not need a paid subscription; free versions work perfectly.

items.q: What do I receive after purchasing?
items.a: Immediately after purchase you receive an email with a link to your Notion document (no Notion account required) and a PDF download. Both contain all prompts organised by category.
No. Every Veltrix pack is a one-time purchase. Pay once, own it forever. No subscriptions, no hidden fees, no recurring charges.
